photos.title: File:The Migrant of Hat Wanakon.jpg
photos.description: A detailed photograph of a Blue-throated Bee-eater (Merops viridis) with insect prey at Hat Wanakon National Park, Prachuap Khiri Khan Province, Thailand. The image documents a crucial ecological phenomenon: the annual migration of this species from Indonesia to breed, nest, and lay eggs during the early rainy season. Hat Wanakon National Park offers the perfect microhabitat, featuring sandy terrain ideal for burrow nesting, surrounded by mature trees and abundant food resources. This photograph captures the bird foraging in a well-managed sanctuary free from human disturbance.
